name: multi-ai-delegation
description: Split big jobs across your other AI chat sites (ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, Perplexity, Copilot) through Claude in Chrome. Claude shows a plan with sites, cost and time and waits for your go, then pilots, runs the chunks in parallel, checks the answers and merges them. Also: a council of models, cross-model reviews, and media jobs with a cost quote first.
